liquidate((address,address,address,addre.notice: Owner-only atomic liquidation. swapTarget2 = address(0) for a single-hop sale; for the dual-hop route, swapTarget1 sells collateral for midToken, swapTarget2 sells midToken for the loan asset. swapData2 = abi.encode(midToken, swapTarget2 == pool2 ? other pool-2 token : ..) is not needed: the leg-2 swap data encodes its own callback data; the midToken parameter carries the token leg 2 pays.

onMorphoLiquidate(uint256,bytes).notice: Morpho external-liquidation callback onMorphoLiquidate(uint256,bytes) (0x`cf7ea196`, same shape as onMorphoFlashLoan; the amount is ignored — the seized collateral is already this contract's balance): sell it.

sweep(address,address,uint256).notice: Owner (the gate deployer = the bot wallet) may withdraw accumulated profits and mid-token dust. Principal at risk is bounded by liquidate()'s revert condition.
